# Design System Intelligence

This document summarizes the active design-system ownership after the mobile foundation update. The exhaustive generated source catalog remains in `docs/architecture/master-system-intelligence.md`.

## Active Owners

- Web shared UI primitives: `packages/typescript/ui`.
- Flutter shared UI primitives: `packages/dart/ui_kit`.
- Mobile merchant app theme adapters: `apps/mobile/merchant-app/lib/theme`.
- Design-system migration blueprint: `docs/mobile-migration-blueprint/DESIGN_SYSTEM_ALIGNMENT.md`.

## Mobile Token Rules

- New mobile UI should consume `letbuyy_ui_kit` and `apps/mobile/merchant-app/lib/theme/*` tokens.
- Avoid adding raw hex colors in new screens. Prefer `AppColors`, `AppThemeColors`, or token aliases.
- Typography should standardize on Inter for merchant/admin surfaces.
- Common state components should use existing loading, empty, and error primitives before introducing new local variants.

## Current Mobile Theme Notes

- The mobile app already has `AppThemeColors`, `StoreAdminColors`, and shared `letbuyy_ui_kit` color APIs.
- `StoreAdminColors` remains a compatibility layer and should converge toward the token layer during feature work.
- The P0 foundation work did not complete the full token migration; remaining raw color cleanup is tracked by the mobile blueprint and status ledger.

## Stale References Removed

This regenerated summary no longer references deleted Firebase/Supabase files such as `firebase_options.dart`, `supabase_config.dart`, `google-services.json`, or old `lib/screens/landing/**` paths.
